SELECT
	BC.AccCode,
	Account=(SELECT Accounts.Name FROM Accounts WHERE Accounts.AccCode = BC.AccCode),
	SubCode =(SELECT Accounts.SubCode FROM Accounts WHERE Accounts.AccCode = BC.AccCode),
	Source=CASE BC.Code 
		WHEN -99 THEN 'Opening Balance' 
		WHEN -100 THEN 'Cashier Shift Excess/Short/Transfer' 
		WHEN -101 THEN 'Cash From Sales' 
		WHEN -102 THEN 'Cash From Service Sales' 
		WHEN -103 THEN 'Cash Paid for Sales Returns' 
		WHEN -104 THEN 'Cash Paid for Servives Sales Returns' 
		WHEN -105 THEN 'Cash Paid for Purchase ' 
		WHEN -106 THEN 'Cash From Purchase Returns' 
		ELSE (SELECT Accounts.Name FROM Accounts WHERE Accounts.AccCode = BC.Code) END,
	BC.Amount,
	BC.Type,
	Bc.CheckNo,
	BC.ID
FROM
	(SELECT V.AccCode, 
		Code=-99,
		Amount = ISNULL(SUM(V.Debit-V.Credit), 0), 
		Type='Opening Balance...............', 
		CheckNo=Space(20),
		id=0
	FROM VirtualGL V
	WHERE
		V.Date < :ar_startdate AND
		V.AccCode IN
			(SELECT AccCode 
			FROM Accounts 
			WHERE SUBCODE IN 
				(SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = LOWER('GT_CashSub') AND (:ar_cashbank=1 OR :ar_cashbank=3)
				UNION
				SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = LOWER('GT_BankSub') AND (:ar_cashbank=2 OR :ar_cashbank=3)
				UNION
				SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name IN (LOWER('GT_CashSub'), LOWER('GT_BankSub')) AND :ar_cashbank=3))
	GROUP BY V.AccCode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 	V.AccCode,
		Code=-100, 
		Amount = ISNULL(Sum(V.Debit), 0), 
		Type='Cashier Shift', 
		CheckNo='',
		Id=1
	FROM VirtualGl V
	WHERE
		V.DocumentType = 'CSHIFT' AND
		V.Debit > 0 AND
		V.Date >= :ar_startdate AND V.Date <= :ar_enddate AND
		V.AccCode IN
			(SELECT AccCode FROM Accounts WHERE SUBCODE IN 
				(SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = LOWER('GT_CashSub') AND (:ar_cashbank=1 OR :ar_cashbank=3)
				UNION
				SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = LOWER('GT_BankSub') AND (:ar_cashbank=2 OR :ar_cashbank=3)
				UNION
				SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name IN (LOWER('GT_CashSub'), LOWER('GT_BankSub')) AND :ar_cashbank=3))
	GROUP BY V.AccCode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 	V.AccCode,
		Code=-101, 
		Amount = ISNULL(Sum(V.Debit), 0), 
		Type='Receipts', 
		CheckNo='',
		Id=1
	FROM VirtualGl V
	WHERE
		V.DocumentType = 'SV' AND
		V.Debit > 0 AND
		V.Date >= :ar_startdate AND V.Date <= :ar_enddate AND
		V.AccCode IN
			(SELECT AccCode FROM Accounts WHERE SUBCODE IN 
				(SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = LOWER('GT_CashSub') AND (:ar_cashbank=1 OR :ar_cashbank=3)
				UNION
				SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = LOWER('GT_BankSub') AND (:ar_cashbank=2 OR :ar_cashbank=3)
				UNION
				SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name IN (LOWER('GT_CashSub'), LOWER('GT_BankSub')) AND :ar_cashbank=3))
	GROUP BY V.AccCode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 	V.AccCode,
		Code=-102, 
		Amount = ISNULL(Sum(V.Debit), 0), 
		Type='Receipts', 
		CheckNo='',
		Id=2
	FROM VirtualGl V
	WHERE
		V.DocumentType = 'RS' AND
		V.Debit > 0 AND
		V.Date >= :ar_startdate AND V.Date <= :ar_enddate AND
		V.AccCode IN
			(SELECT AccCode FROM Accounts WHERE SUBCODE IN 
				(SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = LOWER('GT_CashSub') AND (:ar_cashbank=1 OR :ar_cashbank=3)
				UNION
				SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = LOWER('GT_BankSub') AND (:ar_cashbank=2 OR :ar_cashbank=3)
				UNION
				SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name IN (LOWER('GT_CashSub'), LOWER('GT_BankSub')) AND :ar_cashbank=3))
	GROUP BY V.AccCode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 	V.AccCode,
		Code=-100, 
		Amount = - ISNULL(Sum(V.Credit), 0), 
		Type='Cashier Shift', 
		CheckNo='',
		Id=50
	FROM VirtualGl V
	WHERE
		V.DocumentType = 'CSHIFT' AND
		V.Credit > 0 AND
		V.Date >= :ar_startdate AND V.Date <= :ar_enddate AND
		V.AccCode IN
			(SELECT AccCode FROM Accounts WHERE SUBCODE IN 
				(SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = LOWER('GT_CashSub') AND (:ar_cashbank=1 OR :ar_cashbank=3)
				UNION
				SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = LOWER('GT_BankSub') AND (:ar_cashbank=2 OR :ar_cashbank=3)
				UNION
				SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name IN (LOWER('GT_CashSub'), LOWER('GT_BankSub')) AND :ar_cashbank=3))
	GROUP BY V.AccCode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 	V.AccCode,
		Code=-103, 
		Amount = - ISNULL(Sum(V.Credit), 0), 
		Type='Payments', 
		CheckNo='',
		Id=50
	FROM VirtualGl V
	WHERE
		V.DocumentType = 'SR' AND
		V.Credit > 0 AND
		V.Date >= :ar_startdate AND V.Date <= :ar_enddate AND
		V.AccCode IN
			(SELECT AccCode FROM Accounts WHERE SUBCODE IN 
				(SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = LOWER('GT_CashSub') AND (:ar_cashbank=1 OR :ar_cashbank=3)
				UNION
				SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = LOWER('GT_BankSub') AND (:ar_cashbank=2 OR :ar_cashbank=3)
				UNION
				SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name IN (LOWER('GT_CashSub'), LOWER('GT_BankSub')) AND :ar_cashbank=3))
	GROUP BY V.AccCode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 	V.AccCode,
		Code=-104, 
		Amount = - ISNULL(Sum(V.Credit), 0), 
		Type='Payments', 
		CheckNo='',
		Id=50
	FROM VirtualGl V
	WHERE
		V.DocumentType = 'RR' AND
		V.Credit > 0 AND
		V.Date >= :ar_startdate AND V.Date <= :ar_enddate AND
		V.AccCode IN
			(SELECT AccCode FROM Accounts WHERE SUBCODE IN 
				(SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = LOWER('GT_CashSub') AND (:ar_cashbank=1 OR :ar_cashbank=3)
				UNION
				SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = LOWER('GT_BankSub') AND (:ar_cashbank=2 OR :ar_cashbank=3)
				UNION
				SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name IN (LOWER('GT_CashSub'), LOWER('GT_BankSub')) AND :ar_cashbank=3))
	GROUP BY V.AccCode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 	V.AccCode,
		Code=-105, 
		Amount = - ISNULL(Sum(V.Credit), 0), 
		Type='Payments', 
		CheckNo='',
		Id=50
	FROM VirtualGl V
	WHERE
		V.DocumentType = 'PV' AND
		V.Credit > 0 AND
		V.Date >= :ar_startdate AND V.Date <= :ar_enddate AND
		V.AccCode IN
			(SELECT AccCode FROM Accounts WHERE SUBCODE IN 
				(SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = LOWER('GT_CashSub') AND (:ar_cashbank=1 OR :ar_cashbank=3)
				UNION
				SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = LOWER('GT_BankSub') AND (:ar_cashbank=2 OR :ar_cashbank=3)
				UNION
				SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name IN (LOWER('GT_CashSub'), LOWER('GT_BankSub')) AND :ar_cashbank=3))
	GROUP BY V.AccCode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 	V.AccCode,
		Code=-106, 
		Amount = ISNULL(Sum(V.Debit), 0), 
		Type='Receipts', 
		CheckNo='',
		Id=3
	FROM VirtualGl V
	WHERE
		V.DocumentType = 'PR' AND
		V.Debit > 0 AND
		V.Date >= :ar_startdate AND V.Date <= :ar_enddate AND
		V.AccCode IN
			(SELECT AccCode FROM Accounts WHERE SUBCODE IN 
				(SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = LOWER('GT_CashSub') AND (:ar_cashbank=1 OR :ar_cashbank=3)
				UNION
				SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = LOWER('GT_BankSub') AND (:ar_cashbank=2 OR :ar_cashbank=3)
				UNION
				SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name IN (LOWER('GT_CashSub'), LOWER('GT_BankSub')) AND :ar_cashbank=3))
	GROUP BY V.AccCode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 	GL.AccCode,	/*Cash/Bank Receipts & Payments Customized For CASH/BANK (Other than JV)*/
		Code=GD.AccCode, 
		Amount = ISNULL(GD.Credit - GD.Debit, 0), 
		Type=CASE WHEN GD.Credit - GD.Debit > 0 THEN 'Receipts' ELSE 'Payments' END, 
		CheckNo=ISNULL(GD.ChkNo, ''),
		Id=CASE WHEN GD.Credit - GD.Debit > 0  THEN 11 ELSE 51 END
	FROM GlDetail GD, GlHeader GL, VocherCategory VC
	WHERE
		GL.Posted='Y' AND
		GL.Date >= :ar_startdate AND GL.Date <= :ar_enddate AND
		GL.GlVochCode = GD.GlVochCode AND
		GL.VochCatCode = VC.VochCatCode AND
		VC.JournalVoucher=0 AND
		GL.AccCode <> GD.AccCode AND	
		GL.AccCode IN
			(SELECT AccCode FROM Accounts WHERE SUBCODE IN 
				(SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = LOWER('GT_CashSub') AND (:ar_cashbank=1 OR :ar_cashbank=3)
				UNION
				SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = LOWER('GT_BankSub') AND (:ar_cashbank=2 OR :ar_cashbank=3)
				UNION
				SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name IN (LOWER('GT_CashSub'), LOWER('GT_BankSub')) AND :ar_cashbank=3))
	UNION ALL
	SELECT GD.AccCode,	/*Cash/Bank Receipts & Payments Customized For CASH/BANK (Other than JV) CONTRA AFFECT*/
		Code=GL.AccCode, 
		Amount = ISNULL(GD.Debit - GD.Credit, 0), 
		Type=CASE WHEN GD.Debit - GD.Credit > 0 THEN 'Receipts' ELSE 'Payments' END, 
		CheckNo=ISNULL(GD.ChkNo, ''),
		Id=CASE WHEN GD.Debit - GD.Credit > 0 THEN 12 ELSE 52 END
	FROM GlDetail GD, GlHeader GL, VocherCategory VC
	WHERE
		GL.POsted='Y' AND
		GL.Date >= :ar_startdate AND GL.Date <= :ar_enddate AND
		GL.GlVochCode = GD.GlVochCode AND
		GL.VochCatCode = VC.VochCatCode AND
		VC.JournalVoucher=0 AND
		GL.AccCode <> GD.AccCode AND
		GD.AccCode IN
			(SELECT AccCode FROM Accounts WHERE SUBCODE IN 
				(SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = LOWER('GT_CashSub') AND (:ar_cashbank=1 OR :ar_cashbank=3)
				UNION
				SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = LOWER('GT_BankSub') AND (:ar_cashbank=2 OR :ar_cashbank=3)
				UNION
				SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name IN (LOWER('GT_CashSub'), LOWER('GT_BankSub')) AND :ar_cashbank=3)) AND
		GL.AccCode IN
			(SELECT AccCode FROM Accounts WHERE SUBCODE IN 
				(SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = LOWER('GT_CashSub') AND (:ar_cashbank=1 OR :ar_cashbank=3)
				UNION
				SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = LOWER('GT_BankSub') AND (:ar_cashbank=2 OR :ar_cashbank=3)
				UNION
				SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name IN (LOWER('GT_CashSub'), LOWER('GT_BankSub')) AND :ar_cashbank=3))
	UNION ALL
	SELECT GD.AccCode,	/*Cash/Bank Receipts & Payments (Other than JV) NOT Customized For CASH/BANK*/
		Code=GL.AccCode, 
		Amount = ISNULL(GD.Debit - GD.Credit, 0), 
		Type=CASE WHEN GD.Debit > 0 THEN 'Receipts' ELSE 'Payments' END, 
		CheckNo=ISNULL(GD.ChkNo, ''),
		Id=CASE WHEN GD.Debit > 0 THEN 13 ELSE 53 END
	FROM GlDetail GD, GlHeader GL, VocherCategory VC
	WHERE
		GL.POsted='Y' AND
		GL.Date >= :ar_startdate AND GL.Date <= :ar_enddate AND
		GL.VochCatCode = VC.VochCatCode AND
		VC.JournalVoucher=0 AND
		GL.GlVochCode = GD.GlVochCode AND
		GD.AccCode IN
			(SELECT AccCode FROM Accounts WHERE SUBCODE IN 
				(SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = LOWER('GT_CashSub') AND (:ar_cashbank=1 OR :ar_cashbank=3)
				UNION
				SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = LOWER('GT_BankSub') AND (:ar_cashbank=2 OR :ar_cashbank=3)
				UNION
				SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name IN (LOWER('GT_CashSub'), LOWER('GT_BankSub')) AND :ar_cashbank=3)) AND
		GL.AccCode NOT IN
			(SELECT AccCode FROM Accounts WHERE SUBCODE IN 
				(SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = LOWER('GT_CashSub') AND (:ar_cashbank=1 OR :ar_cashbank=3)
				UNION
				SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = LOWER('GT_BankSub') AND (:ar_cashbank=2 OR :ar_cashbank=3)
				UNION
				SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name IN (LOWER('GT_CashSub'), LOWER('GT_BankSub')) AND :ar_cashbank=3))
	UNION ALL
	SELECT GD.AccCode,	/*Journal Vocher Cash/Bank Receipts OR Payments*/
		Code=GD.AccCode, 
		Amount = ISNULL(Debit - GD.Credit, 0), 
		Type= CASE WHEN Debit > 0 THEN 'Receipts' ELSE 'Payments' END,
		CheckNo=ISNULL(GD.ChkNo, ''),
		Id= CASE WHEN Debit > 0 THEN 14 ELSE 54 END
	FROM GlDetail GD, GlHeader GL, VocherCategory VC
	WHERE
		GL.POsted='Y' AND
		GL.Date >= :ar_startdate AND GL.Date <= :ar_enddate AND
		GL.VochCatCode = VC.VochCatCode AND
		VC.JournalVoucher=1 AND
		GL.GlVochCode = GD.GlVochCode AND
		GD.AccCode IN
			(SELECT AccCode FROM Accounts WHERE SUBCODE IN 
				(SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = LOWER('GT_CashSub') AND (:ar_cashbank=1 OR :ar_cashbank=3)
				UNION
				SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = LOWER('GT_BankSub') AND (:ar_cashbank=2 OR :ar_cashbank=3)
				UNION
				SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name IN (LOWER('GT_CashSub'), LOWER('GT_BankSub')) AND :ar_cashbank=3))
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 	V.AccCode,
		Code=V.AccCode, 
		Amount = ISNULL(V.Debit - V.Credit, 0), 
		Type=CASE WHEN ISNULL(V.Debit - V.Credit, 0) > 0 THEN 'Receipts' ELSE 'Payments' END, 
		CheckNo=ISNULL(V.CheckNo, ''),
		Id=CASE WHEN V.Debit > 0 THEN 15 ELSE 55 END
	FROM VirtualGl V
	WHERE
		V.DocumentType IN ('NR', 'NP') AND
		V.Date >= :ar_startdate AND V.Date <= :ar_enddate AND
		V.AccCode IN
			(SELECT AccCode FROM Accounts WHERE SUBCODE IN 
				(SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = LOWER('GT_CashSub') AND (:ar_cashbank=1 OR :ar_cashbank=3)
				UNION
				SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = LOWER('GT_BankSub') AND (:ar_cashbank=2 OR :ar_cashbank=3)
				UNION
				SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name IN (LOWER('GT_CashSub'), LOWER('GT_BankSub')) AND :ar_cashbank=3))
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 	V.AccCode,
		Code=V.AccCode, 
		Amount = ISNULL(V.Debit - V.Credit, 0), 
		Type=CASE WHEN ISNULL(V.Debit - V.Credit, 0) > 0 THEN 'Receipts' ELSE 'Payments' END, 
		CheckNo=ISNULL(V.CheckNo, ''),
		Id=CASE WHEN V.Debit > 0 THEN 16 ELSE 56 END
	FROM VirtualGl V
	WHERE
		V.DocumentType IN ('PAY','PAYD') AND
		V.Date >= :ar_startdate AND V.Date <= :ar_enddate AND
		V.AccCode IN
			(SELECT AccCode FROM Accounts WHERE SUBCODE IN 
				(SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = LOWER('GT_CashSub') AND (:ar_cashbank=1 OR :ar_cashbank=3)
				UNION
				SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = LOWER('GT_BankSub') AND (:ar_cashbank=2 OR :ar_cashbank=3)
				UNION
				SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name IN (LOWER('GT_CashSub'), LOWER('GT_BankSub')) AND :ar_cashbank=3))) BC
WHERE BC.AccCode IN 
	(SELECT DISTINCT AccCode FROM VirtualGL WHERE DATE BETWEEN :ar_startdate AND :ar_enddate AND :ar_transacconly=1
	UNION
	SELECT AccCode FROM Accounts WHERE :ar_transacconly=0 AND 
		SUBCODE IN 
			(SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = LOWER('GT_CashSub') AND (:ar_cashbank=1 OR :ar_cashbank=3)
			UNION
			SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name = LOWER('GT_BankSub') AND (:ar_cashbank=2 OR :ar_cashbank=3)
			UNION
			SELECT Code FROM Global WHERE Name IN (LOWER('GT_CashSub'), LOWER('GT_BankSub')) AND :ar_cashbank=3))
ORDER BY
	id,
	TYPE Desc,
	Account,
	source
table.sort: id A, type D, source A, checkno A

objects.name: c_startdate
objects.expression: "Report Date:" + string(today(), 'dd/mm/yyyy hh:mm:ss') + SPACE(10) + "From :" +  STRING(ar_startdate, 'dd/mm/yyyy hh:mm:ss') + SPACE(10) + "To :" +  STRING(ar_enddate, 'dd/mm/yyyy hh:mm:ss')

props.sourcenames: acccode, account, subcode, source, amount, type, checkno, id
